Definition: No (i.e. Thebes), the capital of Upper Egypt
BiblicalUsage: No is Thebes, the populous city among the rivers, whose rampart was the sea and her wall from the sea. The prophets ask whether any city is better than populous No, and God says He will punish the multitude of No and execute judgments in her.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that no wall of water saves a city God judges: populous No had the rivers round about her, and the LORD still reached her.
